Using the incident-management policy’s SEV-1 definition — “complete platform outage or data loss affecting all customers” [TechNova_OnCall_Runbook.pdf::sec2] — and the post-incident process that applies to all SEV-1 incidents [TechNova_OnCall_Runbook.pdf::sec4], the SEV-1 incidents **reported in calendar year 2025** (interpreted from the `incidents.reported_date` field) are:

| Incident Ref | Affected Service | Reporter | Remediation Cost (₹ lakhs) |
|---|---|---|---:|
| INC-2025-0055 | data-svc-24 | Vikram Das | 60 |
| INC-2025-0008 | TechNova-Extract | Meera Das | 13 |
| INC-2025-0027 | data-svc-26 | Pooja Gupta | 85 |

**Combined remediation cost: ₹158 lakhs.**

Cross-check: 3 SEV-1 incidents matched the 2025 `reported_date` filter, and their remediation costs sum to ₹158 lakhs. [TechNova_OnCall_Runbook.pdf::sec2][TechNova_OnCall_Runbook.pdf::sec4]

sql.query:
SELECT i.incident_ref, s.service_name AS affected_service, e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS reporter_name, i.remediation_cost_inr_lakhs
FROM incidents i
JOIN products_services s ON i.affected_service_id = s.service_id
JOIN employees e ON i.reporter_employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE i.severity = 'SEV-1'
  AND CAST(i.reported_date AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND CAST(i.reported_date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
ORDER BY CAST(i.reported_date AS DATE), i.incident_ref;
